title: Status board row-flip loop
summary: A black status board of five label/value rows under a split wordmark. Rows roll to a second copy set one by one, top to bottom, while an amber arrow dashes right and creeps back. Reads like a transit board and loops seamlessly.
use_when: Announcing a collection, release or schedule as a list of short label/value facts
Bilingual or two-message loops where the same rows swap copy in place
Travel, transport, logistics or event products that want a timetable voice
Silent autoplay loops for a site hero or social feed

look.type_style: header: bold geometric grotesk, uppercase, tight, ~10 % H, split left/right with an amber arrow; board: monospaced uppercase, regular tracking, ~4.5 % H, labels warm white left, values amber right; tiny mono column heads

sfx.event: each board row settles on its new copy
arrow dashes right across the header

structure.shot: split wordmark header with amber arrow beside the first word; board of 5 label/value rows in copy set A; tiny column heads
rows swap to copy set B one by one, top to bottom; label and value of a row swap together
structure.motion: per row: old line rises ~0.1 row and fades 3 fr, new line rises from ~0.1 row below and fades in 3 fr (easings.outQuint), ~6 fr per row; stagger 4 fr; cascade f16-f32

structure.shot: board holds set B; the amber arrow dashes right from the first word toward the second
structure.motion: arrow travels ~40 % of frame width, easings.inOutSine ~24 fr (f30-f54, ±3 fr), settles with no overshoot

structure.shot: board holds set B; arrow creeps back left
structure.motion: arrow easings.linear back-drift ~3.8 px/fr @1920 that runs until the end; board static

structure.shot: rows swap back to copy set A one by one, top to bottom
structure.motion: same per-row roll as row 2 (3 fr out, 3 fr in, easings.outQuint), stagger 4-5 fr; cascade f136-f160; arrow keeps its linear drift

structure.shot: board holds set A; arrow drifts back to its start beside the first word, matching frame 0
structure.motion: arrow easings.linear drift continues; ends within ~1 % of its frame-0 position so the loop is seamless

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the header, mono for the board, fg for labels, accent for values and the arrow, bg
params.content.header: two words of the product name, split left and right of the arrow
params.content.columns: two tiny column heads (label side, value side)
params.content.setA: 5 rows of {label, value}: label ≤ 4 words, value ≤ 3 words
params.content.setB: 5 rows of {label, value} that replace set A in place (translation or second message)
params.timing.rowStagger: frames between row swaps (default 4 at 30 fps)
params.timing.swapA: frame the swap to set B starts (default 16)
params.timing.swapB: frame the swap back to set A starts (default 136)
params.timing.arrowDash: arrow dash start and length in frames (default 30, 24)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured on 30 fps strips: swap 1 runs f16-f32, swap 2 f136-f160; per row ~3 fr out + 3 fr in with a small vertical roll, row stagger 4 fr, label and value of a row swap on the same frame. Arrow dash f30-f54, then a constant drift back for ~7 s that lands on its frame-0 position, so the loop needs no transition. No camera move: motion.json 'camera-mixed' seconds are the arrow. Hint 'device-phone' not seen. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): row-flip-cascade, arrow-shuttle. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
